environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.62 on EC2 (m5.large), Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. PostgreSQL 14.3 on RDS (db.r5.large) in same VPC. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to NLB, NLB target group forwards to port 8443 on EC2. RDS security group allows 5432 from EC2 SG. DB user 'app_reports' has SELECT on all tables in 'finance' schema. No application-layer filtering or proxy between client and Tomcat.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14.3, user app_reports with SELECT on finance.*
config.network: Public subnet NLB -> private subnet EC2 -> private subnet RDS
config.db_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA finance TO app_reports
